note: There was no US Dodge Magnum for 1980-2004. The 1978-1979 Magnum XE (GT was an option package) was a B-body coupe that replaced the Charger SE; the nameplate returned for 2005 on the LX-platform wagon (SE, SXT, R/T, SRT8), built through 2008. HP is SAE net. 1978-79 California/high-altitude engines (318 4-bbl, 360 4-bbl) are described in notes, not listed as separate engines. NHRA covers only 1978-79.
